subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept a shared core `/stream` command plus `previewStreamingSessionOverride` channel capability for Telegram, Discord, and Slack once the correctness and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing command, a persisted session field, and a public channel capability; code review can identify blockers, but maintainer product/API intent decides whether that surface belongs in core now.

options.title: Accept after blockers
options.body: Keep the shared command/API direction, but require the Discord/Slack suppression fix, focused regressions, and live channel proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer
options.body: Leave the linked feature issue open and ask for a smaller MVP or different storage/API shape before this branch proceeds.

options.title: Reject core surface
options.body: Close this PR as not planned for core and direct any future work to a different plugin or product surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep the shared command/API direction, but require the Discord/Slack suppression fix, focused regressions, and live channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-command history and broad OpenClaw product-surface work make steipete the best available routing owner for the command/API direction choice.
